name: E10_5_dwynen_the_attacking_elves_are_counted_when_the_ability_resolves
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever Dwynen attacks, you gain 1 life for each attacking Elf you control.' Seat 0 attacks with Dwynen and two Elves. With Dwynen's trigger waiting on the stack, one Elf is put into the graveyard in response. The life gain counts the attacking Elves seat 0 controls as the ability resolves: Dwynen and the one Elf left, two, so seat 0 gains 2 (22), not the 3 there were when it triggered. The Elf that was removed is in the graveyard. The two attackers left deal 3 (Dwynen) + 3 (the Elf, 2/2 with Dwynen's bonus): seat 1 at 14.
